analysis.summaryJa: 語の長さと語尾の綴りを手掛かりに、-er/-est型とmore/most型を選び、y変化や末尾子音の重ね書きを正しく行う。
grammarPoints: 短い形容詞・副詞は-er/-estを基本とする
子音字+yはyをiに変えて-er/-estを付ける
短母音+子音で終わる短語は末尾子音を重ねる
visualEvidence: 二つの分岐矢印が-er型とmore型を示す
yからiへの書き換えが色分けされる
bigのgが二重になる図がCVC規則を示す
比較級と最上級の階段が二段階を示す
commonTraps: more easierのように二重比較にしない

questions.prompt: The revised form is ------- than the version used last year.
questions.translationJa: 改訂用紙は昨年版より短いです。
questions.explanationJa: 短い形容詞shortの比較級はshorterです。

questions.prompt: Of the four proposals, Plan C is the ------- to implement.
questions.translationJa: 4案のうち、C案が最も実施しやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: easyはyをiに変えてeasiestとなります。

questions.prompt: The customer service workshop was ------- informative than the general orientation.
questions.translationJa: 顧客対応研修は一般説明会より有益でした。
questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞informativeはmoreを使って比較級にします。

questions.prompt: The new loading area is ------- than the temporary one.
questions.translationJa: 新しい積み込み場所は仮設場所より広いです。
questions.explanationJa: bigは末尾gを重ねてbiggerとします。

questions.prompt: This route is ------- convenient for delivery trucks than the coastal road.
questions.translationJa: この経路は海岸道路より配送トラックに便利です。
questions.explanationJa: convenientは長い語なのでmore convenientを使います。

questions.prompt: The March newsletter was the ------- issue published this year.
questions.translationJa: 3月号は今年発行された中で最も生き生きした号でした。
questions.explanationJa: livelyはyをiに変え、最上級liveliestにします。

questions.prompt: The compliance manual is ------- complicated than the quick-reference card.
questions.translationJa: コンプライアンス手引きは早見表より複雑です。
questions.explanationJa: complicatedはmore complicatedとします。
questions.focus: 多音節形容詞の比較級

questions.prompt: The west wing has the ------- meeting room in the building.
questions.translationJa: 西棟には建物内で最大の会議室があります。
questions.explanationJa: largeの最上級はlargestです。

questions.prompt: The afternoon shift was ------- than the morning shift because two employees were absent.
questions.translationJa: 2人欠勤したため午後勤務は午前勤務より忙しかったです。
questions.explanationJa: busyはyをiに変えてbusierとします。

questions.prompt: Among the available packages, the annual plan offers the ------- flexible cancellation terms.
questions.translationJa: 利用可能なプランの中で年間プランが最も柔軟な解約条件を提供します。
questions.explanationJa: 範囲内の最上級で、長いflexibleにはmostを置きます。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two delivery dates?

choices.A: Friday is more late than Thursday.
choices.D: Friday is more later than Thursday.

questions.translationJa: 金曜日は木曜日より遅いです。
questions.explanationJa: lateはlaterとし、moreを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly identifies the top-rated design?

choices.B: This is the more attractive design of all.
choices.C: This is the most attractiver design.
choices.D: This is the most attractive design.

questions.translationJa: これは最も魅力的なデザインです。
questions.explanationJa: attractiveはmost attractiveで最上級にします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two busy periods?

choices.C: Monday was more busier than Tuesday.
choices.D: Monday was the busiest than Tuesday.

questions.translationJa: 月曜日は火曜日より忙しかったです。
questions.explanationJa: busyはyをiに変えてbusierです。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two warehouse sizes?

choices.A: Warehouse A is biger than Warehouse B.
choices.B: Warehouse A is more bigger than Warehouse B.
choices.C: Warehouse A is bigger than Warehouse B.
choices.D: Warehouse A is biggest than Warehouse B.

questions.translationJa: A倉庫はB倉庫より大きいです。
questions.explanationJa: bigはgを重ねてbiggerとします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two instructions?

choices.A: The online instructions are understandabler than the leaflet.
choices.B: The online instructions are most understandable than the leaflet.
choices.C: The online instructions are more understandabler than the leaflet.
choices.D: The online instructions are more understandable than the leaflet.

questions.translationJa: オンライン説明は冊子より理解しやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: 長いunderstandableはmore understandableを使います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly names the hottest storage room?

choices.B: Room 3 is the most hotter room.
choices.D: Room 3 is the more hot room.

questions.translationJa: 3号室が最も暑い保管室です。
questions.explanationJa: hotはtを重ねてhottestとします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two friendly services?

choices.A: The reception team is more friendly than the call center only correct form.
choices.B: The reception team is friendlier than the call center.
choices.C: The reception team is friendlyer than the call center.
choices.D: The reception team is most friendlier than the call center.

questions.translationJa: 受付チームは電話窓口より親しみやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: friendlyはyをiに変えてfriendlierとできます。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly states the safest option?

choices.A: The rail route is the safest option.
choices.B: The rail route is the most safest option.
choices.C: The rail route is the more safe option of all.
choices.D: The rail route is the safeest option.

questions.translationJa: 鉄道経路が最も安全な選択肢です。
questions.explanationJa: safeはeで終わるためsafestとします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two efficient processes?

choices.A: The revised process is efficienter than the old one.
choices.B: The revised process is most efficient than the old one.
choices.C: The revised process is more efficienter than the old one.
choices.D: The revised process is more efficient than the old one.

questions.translationJa: 改訂工程は旧工程より効率的です。
questions.explanationJa: efficientはmore efficientとします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two narrow aisles?

choices.A: Aisle 2 is more narrower than Aisle 1.
choices.D: Aisle 2 is more narrowest than Aisle 1.

questions.translationJa: 2番通路は1番通路より狭いです。
questions.explanationJa: narrowの比較級narrowerを単独で使います。

questions.prompt: The new invoice is simpler than the old one.

choices.A: The old invoice is the simplest.
choices.C: The new invoice is more complicated.
choices.D: The old invoice is more complicated than the new one.

questions.translationJa: 新しい請求書は旧版より簡単です。
questions.explanationJa: simplerの反対側から、旧版の方が複雑と言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: This is the busiest day of the quarter.

choices.B: No other day this quarter is busier.
choices.C: The quarter has only one day.

questions.translationJa: 今日は四半期で最も忙しい日です。
questions.explanationJa: busiestは他の日がこれを上回らないことを示します。

questions.prompt: The revised proposal is more comprehensive than the first draft.

choices.A: The first draft contains every detail.
choices.C: The revised proposal covers a wider range of details.
choices.D: The revision is shorter and less complete.

questions.translationJa: 改訂提案は初稿より包括的です。
questions.explanationJa: more comprehensiveは内容の範囲・網羅性が高いことを表します。

questions.prompt: Unit B has the biggest display in the series.

choices.A: Every other display in the series is no bigger than Unit B's.
choices.B: Unit B has the smallest display.
choices.C: Only Unit B belongs to the series.
choices.D: All displays are the same size.

questions.translationJa: B型はシリーズ最大の画面を備えています。
questions.explanationJa: biggestはシリーズ内の他の画面がそれを超えない意味です。
questions.focus: 子音重ね最上級の意味

questions.prompt: The revised schedule is more realistic than the original schedule.

choices.A: The original is guaranteed to work.
choices.B: The revision is closer to what can actually be achieved.
choices.D: The original is the most realistic plan.

questions.translationJa: 改訂日程は元の日程より現実的です。
questions.explanationJa: more realisticは実現可能性が相対的に高いことです。
questions.focus: 長語比較級の内容理解

questions.prompt: The west branch is the liveliest location after 6 p.m.

choices.B: It is quieter than every branch.
choices.D: It has the most activity among the locations after 6 p.m.

questions.translationJa: 午後6時以降は西支店が最も活気のある場所です。
questions.explanationJa: liveliestはactivityが最大であることを示します。

questions.prompt: The revised box is thinner than the current box.

choices.A: The current box is thicker than the revised one.
choices.B: The boxes have the same thickness.
choices.C: The revised box is the thickest.

questions.translationJa: 改訂箱は現行箱より薄いです。
questions.explanationJa: thinnerの逆方向はcurrent box is thickerです。

questions.prompt: This is the most reliable courier in our network.

choices.A: The courier has never made a delivery.
choices.C: No courier in the network is more reliable than this one.

questions.translationJa: これは当社ネットワークで最も信頼できる配送業者です。
questions.explanationJa: most reliableは他社がそれを上回らない意味です。

questions.prompt: The training room became sunnier after the partition was removed.

choices.A: It now receives more sunlight than before.
choices.D: The amount of light did not change.

questions.translationJa: 仕切り撤去後、研修室は以前より日当たりが良くなりました。
questions.explanationJa: sunnierはsunnyの比較級で、光が増えたことを示します。

questions.prompt: The automated check is the most accurate method available.

choices.A: It is less accurate than manual review.
choices.D: No available method is more accurate.

questions.translationJa: 自動確認は利用可能な中で最も正確な方法です。
questions.explanationJa: most accurateは利用可能な方法の頂点を示します。

questions.prompt: The old corridor is 1.2 meters wide, and the renovated one is 1.8 meters wide. The renovated corridor is -------.
questions.translationJa: 改装後の廊下の方が幅広です。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの幅を比べるのでwideの比較級widerです。

questions.prompt: The committee compared six onboarding systems. It chose System M because it was the ------- option for remote staff.
questions.translationJa: 6システム中、Mが在宅職員に最も便利な選択肢でした。
questions.explanationJa: 六つの中の最上級でmost convenientを使います。

questions.prompt: Orders increased from 800 to 1,400 per day. Friday was the ------- day the warehouse had experienced all month.
questions.translationJa: 金曜日はその月で倉庫が経験した最も忙しい日でした。
questions.explanationJa: busyの最上級はbusiestです。

questions.prompt: The former database took ten seconds to search; the new one takes three. The new database is -------.
questions.translationJa: 新しいデータベースの方が高速です。
questions.explanationJa: 二者の速度差にはfastの比較級fasterを使います。

questions.prompt: The technical guide contains diagrams, examples, and a glossary. It is ------- than the one-page notice.
questions.translationJa: 技術手引きは1ページの通知より包括的です。
questions.explanationJa: 長いcomprehensiveにはmoreを用います。

questions.prompt: Of the five storage units, Unit E has 900 square meters of floor space. It is the ------- unit.
questions.translationJa: 5区画中、E区画が最大です。
questions.explanationJa: bigの最上級biggestを使います。

questions.prompt: The first draft had several vague sections. After editing, the instructions are much -------.
questions.translationJa: 編集後、説明はずっと明快になりました。
questions.explanationJa: clearの比較級clearerをmuchで強調します。

questions.prompt: Customer satisfaction was 72 percent in May and 84 percent in June. Customers were ------- in June.
questions.translationJa: 6月の顧客の方が満足していました。
questions.explanationJa: happyはyをiに変えてhappierです。

questions.prompt: The panel tested every proposed material under heat and pressure. Alloy P proved to be the ------- material.
questions.translationJa: 全材料の中でP合金が最も耐久性の高い材料でした。
questions.explanationJa: durableはmost durableで最上級にします。

questions.prompt: The revised logo uses fewer elements and stronger contrast. Reviewers found it ------- than the original.
questions.translationJa: 審査者は改訂ロゴの方が元のものより記憶に残ると判断しました。
questions.explanationJa: 二者比較で長いmemorableにはmoreを付けます。
